description.value: Charisma Social Club House is a long-standing family-run cafe in Vancouver's Chinatown, celebrated for housemade soups, award-winning cheesecakes, and boutique bubble teas served late into the evening. The spacious venue doubles as a vibrant community hub, hosting regular language exchanges, creative workshops, paint-and-sip nights, and chef-led pop-ups throughout the week. Its central Chinatown location makes it a lively and welcoming stop for cyclists exploring the downtown core.
